detect_outliers_and_interpolate: detect outliers in 3D human pose keypoints and interpolate missing values using a full postprocessing pipeline
fix_smoothing_mistakes: fix jitter in 3D pose trajectories by detecting excessive motion between consecutive timesteps and interpolating
fix_limb_mistakes: fix limb length outliers in 3D poses by flagging keypoints that violate statistical limb length bounds
fill_missing_keypoints: fill missing 3D pose keypoints by interpolating x, y, z coordinates using polynomial or sliding window methods
smooth_keypoints: smooth 3D pose keypoints over time using a Savitzky-Golay filter with configurable window length and polynomial order
